newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ MCI opens up over 100 bp below RB desired level.
newsitem.headline: NZ MCI opens up over 100 bp below RB desired level.

text.p: The New Zealand Monetary Conditions Index opened on Friday over 100 basis points below the Reserve Bank's desired level.
The index was at 724.09 at 7.45 a.m. (1945 GMT), 101 basis points below the 825 l stated as desired in the September quarter by the Reserve Bank.
The index widened as the New Zealand dollar Trade-Weighted Index opened at 65.05 from its 65.60 close on Thursday.
The MCI is made up of the TWI and the 90-day bank bill rate.
